description: This Java class 'DefaultPackagingImpl' implements the 'Packaging' interface to calculate packaging details for shipping products, including box fitting logic and item packaging. It handles configuration, product dimension validation, and packing itemization.

classes.name: DefaultPackagingImpl
classes.description: Implements the Packaging interface to provide shipping packing logic, including box and item packaging calculations.

methods.name: getItemPackagesDetails
